changelog: Title logos for titles outside your library: when the catalog has no logo, the title details endpoint now asks Jellyfin's own image providers (its built-in TMDB access, plus Fanart.tv if that plugin is installed), prefers an English logo, and keeps it for next time. Requires Jellyfin 12.1 or later. This is a beta release.
